modalities.evidence: High-resolution whole-brain anatomical images were acquired using a standard T1-weighted 3D MP-RAGE protocol

output.population: Participants who viewed affect-eliciting audiovisual clips
output.summary: Task fMRI dataset in which participants passively viewed affect-eliciting audiovisual clips spanning four quadrants of valence and arousal, acquired on a Siemens 3T scanner with a slow event-related design plus T1-weighted anatomical scans.
